---
title: "Time-of-Day Activity Explorer (2021–2026)"
subtitle: "Investigating 2,101 timestamped visual sightings across hours, seasons, and coastal zones"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

dolphins_timed <- read_csv("data/florida_dolphins_2021_2026.csv") |>
  distinct(gbif_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(!is.na(event_time), event_time != "") |>
  mutate(
    hour = as.integer(substr(event_time, 1, 2)),
    day_period = case_when(
      hour >= 6  & hour < 12 ~ "Morning (06:00–11:59)",
      hour >= 12 & hour < 17 ~ "Afternoon (12:00–16:59)",
      hour >= 17 & hour < 21 ~ "Evening (17:00–20:59)",
      TRUE                   ~ "Night / Pre-Dawn (21:00–05:59)"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c(
        "Morning (06:00–11:59)",
        "Afternoon (12:00–16:59)",
        "Evening (17:00–20:59)",
        "Night / Pre-Dawn (21:00–05:59)"
      )),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      TRUE                   ~ "Autumn"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn"))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(hour), hour >= 0, hour <= 23)
```

Out of 2,206 sightings in our 2021–2026 dataset, **2,101 records (95.2%)** include an exact local clock timestamp (`105` records reported only the date and are excluded below rather than assigned an artificial hour).

> **Critical methodological note on effort:** Visual sightings require daylight and human observers on boats, piers, or beaches. Sharp drop-offs after sunset reflect **visual observer effort**, *not* dolphins sleeping or leaving Sarasota Bay—passive acoustic studies using the Sarasota Bay Listening Network show that dolphins vocalize and forage actively throughout the night.

### Hourly Sightings by Coastal Study Zone

Click zones in the legend to isolate **Sarasota Bay Study Area** versus neighboring Gulf and Atlantic waters.

```{r}
hourly_zone <- dolphins_timed |>
  count(region, hour) |>
  complete(
    region = unique(dolphins_timed$region),
    hour = 0:23,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  )

plot_ly(
  data = hourly_zone,
  x = ~hour,
  y = ~n,
  color = ~region,
  colors = c("#2a9d8f", "#137c8b", "#e63946", "#0b2545"),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  hovertemplate = "<b>%{fullData.name}</b><br>Local Hour: %{x}:00<br>Sightings: %{y}<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Hourly Distribution of Timestamped Visual Sightings (00:00–23:00 Local Time)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Local Hour of Day (24-Hour Clock)", dtick = 2),
    yaxis = list(title = "Verified Sightings (2021–2026)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.22)
  )
```

### Morning vs. Afternoon vs. Evening Across Seasons

Notice how summer heat and afternoon thunderstorms shift coastal sightings earlier into the **morning hours (08:00–11:00)** compared with winter, when mild midday temperatures concentrate sightings in the **afternoon (12:00–16:59)**.

```{r}
period_season <- dolphins_timed |>
  count(season, day_period) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1), .by = season)

plot_ly(
  data = period_season,
  x = ~season,
  y = ~pct,
  color = ~day_period,
  colors = c("#2a9d8f", "#137c8b", "#f4a261", "#0b2545"),
  type = "bar",
  text = ~paste0(n, " sightings (", pct, "%)"),
  hoverinfo = "x+y+text+name"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Share of Sightings by Time-of-Day Window Across Seasons",
    xaxis = list(title = "Season"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Percentage of Seasonal Sightings (%)"),
    barmode = "stack",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.22)
  )
```

### Month × Hour Activity Heatmap

```{r}
mh_grid <- dolphins_timed |>
  count(month, hour) |>
  complete(month = 1:12, hour = 0:23, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  mutate(month_abb = factor(month.abb[month], levels = rev(month.abb)))

plot_ly(
  data = mh_grid,
  x = ~hour,
  y = ~month_abb,
  z = ~n,
  type = "heatmap",
  colors = c("#f7fbff", "#9ecae1", "#2171b5", "#0b2545"),
  hovertemplate = "Month: %{y}<br>Hour: %{x}:00<br>Sightings: %{z}<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Hour-by-Month Visual Observation Density (2,101 Timestamped Records)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of Day (0–23)", dtick = 2),
    yaxis = list(title = "Month")
  )
```
